source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPad
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If your screen still isn't working, you might need to set up service for your device.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: If your screen still isn't working, you might need to set up service for your device.
source_refs.extraction_method: Exact wording from the 2026-11-17 source check of the Get support section; added after review because the existing steps do not cover a fully unresponsive screen

author_note: The user cannot remove the case, so the remove cases or screen protectors step is left out. The intro states the limit of the steps and that the steps below can be tried without removing the case, and the Get support sentence is the final step.

correction_history.reason: The steps come from a section for too-sensitive or intermittent screens, so the intro now says so and the Get support sentence is added as a final step, which the earlier target omitted.

The intro said the steps are for screens that are too sensitive or intermittent and told the user to try them for a dead screen, so the intro now states that scope and that the steps can be tried without removing the case.
Owner fix from review: Removed the unsupported sentence about fully unresponsive screens; the intro now states only the page's scope.
